description:
## Why

The framework/policy split is a public-API breaking change for downstream consumers of `pkix-profiles` and `pkix-lint`. Migration needs to be documented at the workspace level.

## What

### Top-level README.md updates

1. Crate table: add `pkix-profiles-cabf` and `pkix-lint-cabf` rows. Mark them as 'CA/B Forum reference (not authoritative).' Possibly a separate sub-table for the `-cabf` reference crates so the distinction is visually clear.
2. New section near the architecture overview explaining the framework/policy split philosophy. One paragraph.

### CHANGELOG.md updates

New top-of-file entry under `[unreleased]`:

```
### Workspace: framework / policy split (2026-05-11)

CA/B Forum-specific profile and lint implementations moved out of
`pkix-profiles` and `pkix-lint` into sibling reference crates:

  pkix-profiles  →  pkix-profiles-cabf  (TlsBrProfile, SmimeBrProfile family)
  pkix-lint      →  pkix-lint-cabf      (cabf.br.* lint bundles)

The `-cabf` crates carry a 'reference, not authoritative' framing and
are explicitly not maintained as a canonical CA/B Forum encoding.

Migration for downstream consumers:

  # Cargo.toml
  - pkix-profiles = "0.x"
  + pkix-profiles = "y.0"
  + pkix-profiles-cabf = "0.1"

  # imports
  - use pkix_profiles::TlsBrProfile;
  + use pkix_profiles_cabf::TlsBrProfile;

Same pattern for `pkix-lint` rule-bundle identifiers ("cabf.br.tls"
moves to `pkix-lint-cabf`).

`pkix-profiles` retains the `Profile` trait, `ValidationPolicy`
struct, framework helpers, and adds `BasicSmimeProfile` (RFC 8551 §3)
+ `BasicTlsProfile` (RFC 5280 + RFC 6125 + serverAuth EKU) as
standards-baseline references.

`pkix-lint` retains the `Lint` trait, `LintRunner`, `Finding`,
`EvaluationReport`, `DeviationStore`, and the RFC-conformance lint
bundle.

See PKIX-amgn for the full rationale and the framework/policy
stance encoded in AGENTS.md.
```

### Per-crate README updates

- `pkix-profiles/README.md` — note in the intro that this crate is framework + RFC-baseline references. CA/B Forum content lives in `pkix-profiles-cabf`.
- `pkix-lint/README.md` — same framing.

## Acceptance

- [ ] Top-level README has the new `-cabf` crate rows.
- [ ] CHANGELOG entry committed with the migration guide.
- [ ] `pkix-profiles/README.md` and `pkix-lint/README.md` updated.

## Depends on

PKIX-amgn.2, PKIX-amgn.3, PKIX-amgn.4, PKIX-amgn.5 (crates must exist and have moved content before docs describe the new state).
title: README + CHANGELOG migration docs for the framework/policy split
